attributes.title: Follow the pointer

lesson.concept: A follower needs a resting rule as well as a chase rule
lesson.why: The pointer, ring and halo use different springs while chasing the same input. When input leaves, they return toward the centre instead of remaining stranded at the last edge.
lesson.experiment: Move sharply, stop, and leave the stage. Compare Comet tail with Magnetic pointer and watch the order in which the followers return.
lesson.pitfall: Keeping the last pointer coordinate as the permanent target leaves the demo looking stuck after exit.
lesson.combine: Combine with gestures to distinguish the input location from the control's hover and press states.
